Class AetherisNotebookPanel.UserRun

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.UserRun
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.UserRun extends Object
The UserRun is one user's session binding, the sibling cell runs, and the answers waiting to paint. The binding is the SshTtyConnector for that user. The sibling runs are the AetherisNotebookPanel.CellRun map keyed by cell id. The answers are text waiting for the canvas to paint. The spinner stays on the pane. This type is not a second run object beside that spinner.

  • Method Details

    • anyRunning

      private boolean anyRunning()
      The method reports whether any sibling cell is still in phase RUNNING. The method walks the AetherisNotebookPanel.CellRun map. A phase that is not RUNNING does not count.
      Returns:
      true when at least one cell phase equals RUNNING, and false when none do
